reviewed_by: AI coding assistant; not an independent blinded evaluator
basis: Actual question, answer, required source passages, operational status, and mechanical screens from the retained S15 30-case report. No new model calls were used for this review.
limitations: One run per version during ongoing ingestion; not a frozen-state causal A/B comparison.
Screens test anchors and references, not full entailment. Passing them is not an accuracy claim.
This review flags visible errors and supported core details; it does not certify every extra sentence or learned memory.
The held-out 30 cases were not evaluated in this final run.
